CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_api_keys" (
  "bucket_name" TEXT,
  "can_read" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "can_write" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "is_admin" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "last_used_at" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "token_hint" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("token_hash"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("bucket_name") REFERENCES "buckets" ("name") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
)
